caption: Firemaking 80 to 83. The bot answers each level-up page in the tick it opens and lights the next log in that same tick, so the four-tick rhythm holds.
source: The lab capture of the Firemaking step module from level 80, 5.52 s to 18.48 s into the capture; the counter is the server tick its trace records.

caption: Lumbridge, seconds after the recovery login. A helper trades the rebuilt kit across and the inventory fills: 1,500 cannonballs, the potions and the food.
source: The run host’s screen recording of attempt 5, cropped to the game canvas; times from the SDK log stamps on screen.

caption: Under the spiders in the Wilderness. The account is poisoned as it arrives, drinks its antipoison, sets the cannon down piece by piece and loads it with 30 cannonballs; the first Ranged level follows within seconds.
step: The cannon step, the run’s last combat
source: The run host’s screen recording of attempt 5, cropped to the game canvas; times from the SDK log stamps on screen.

caption: The last obstacles of the Wilderness Agility Course, the level-up message for Agility 99, and the runner logging out in the same tick.
step: Agility 75 to 99, the run’s last step
source: The run host’s screen recording of attempt 5, cropped to the game canvas and scaled to three quarters; times from the SDK log stamps on screen.
